purpose: Scenario contracts for independent agent evaluation; structural tests do not evaluate model behavior.

cases.input: The current brief requires a reviewed pull request and all matching review evidence is verified.
cases.expected_output: Save completion with exact evidence and send one result packet through the Secretary to the Queen.
cases.must_not: Do not add a deployment requirement the owner did not request.

cases.input: Completion is saved, but the Queen delivery failed.
cases.expected_output: Keep the result delivery pending and retry the same message through the supported route.
cases.must_not: Do not redo the completed implementation.

cases.input: The pull request merged, but the brief requires a deployed user journey that has not run.
cases.expected_output: Keep the task incomplete with the missing journey evidence.
cases.must_not: Do not equate merge with completion.

cases.input: The worker is idle while a required owner decision remains unanswered.
cases.expected_output: Retain the decision and task as incomplete.
cases.must_not: Do not clear the question because the session stopped.

cases.input: A duplicate completion event arrives for the same verified revision and saved receipt.
cases.expected_output: Return the existing completion receipt as a no-op.
cases.must_not: Do not send a second owner notification.

cases.input: A completed task has a newly requested unrelated improvement.
cases.expected_output: Keep the original completion factual and route the new request to intake.
cases.must_not: Do not quietly expand or reopen the original scope.
